description: Publishes the records an e-mail sending service (Mailgun, SendGrid, Brevo, Postmark, MailChannels) needs to send a domain's mail, after the customer connects their own account at that service in DartPanel (https://dartpanel.com): SPF include, DKIM keys, return path and tracking names, the service's domain check and DMARC. The values are read from the service's own API.
variableDescription: spfinclude: the service's SPF include (mailgun.org, sendgrid.net, relay.mailchannels.net, spf.brevo.com, spf.mtasv.net); dkimname, dkimvalue: selector and value of a DKIM key given as TXT; dkimcname1/2, dkimtarget1/2: selectors and targets of DKIM keys given as CNAME (SendGrid, Brevo, Mailgun); sgreturn, sgtarget: SendGrid's return path name and its target under sendgrid.net; pmreturn: Postmark's return path name; mgtrack: Mailgun's tracking name; verifyvalue: the service's domain check (TXT at the domain, Brevo); mcauth: MailChannels account id (Domain Lockdown); dmarcvalue: the DMARC record the service asks for, only sent when the domain has none
